verdict.rationale: The only cost-related evidence is the pricing page's 'Spike protection', which detects and flags irregular data volumes. Flagging is an adjacent control, not a per-project event quota cap or a spend limit that stops an error storm from producing a surprise bill. 'Ignore for a specific number of occurrences' is an inbox-triage status, not a quota, so no documented capping or spend-limit capability exists in the evidence.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can cap event quotas per project and set spend limits so an error storm burns a predictable budget, never a surprise invoice
